data: What is the approximate BLEU score of Multi-Unit model at 6 units?

The question asks for the approximate BLEU score of the Multi-Unit model at 6 units. From the caption, we know that the experiments were conducted on the valid set of NIST ZhEn with a decoding batch size of 30 and a beam size of 4. 

Looking at the first graph labeled (a) Effects on BLEU, we can see two lines representing the Multi-Unit and Transformer-Base models. The Multi-Unit line shows an upward trend as the number of units increases. At 6 units, the Multi-Unit line is approximately at 47.5%. Therefore, the approximate BLEU score of the Multi-Unit model at 6 units is 47.5%.
